name: Yo, Matias 6: Contra los Ciber Robots
storyline: Matías is our first cybernetic hero. He must battle powerful virtual robots in an adventure where the action never stops. Stunning graphics and varied levels take place in a fantastical setting. Join him and experience an exciting game in the real world. And in the real world.
summary: Sixth installment on the Yo, Matías comic strip videogame series. A side-scroller platform ambiented on the sci-fi cibernetic world.
